repository.description: Name of the registered CacheRepository (optional; defaults to system default).

CacheClearStep.description: Cache Clear step — removes all entries from a CacheRepository.

coalesce_misses.description:
Coalesce concurrent misses on the same key into a single `on_miss` run
(singleflight). Absent/null means `false`.

key.description: Simple-language expression for the cache key.

on_miss.description: Child sub-pipeline executed on cache miss.

repository.description: Name of the registered CacheRepository (optional; defaults to system default).

key.description:
Simple-language expression for the exact cache key to invalidate.
Mutually exclusive with `key_prefix` (exactly one of the two).

key_prefix.description:
Simple-language expression for the namespace prefix to invalidate.
Mutually exclusive with `key` (exactly one of the two).

repository.description: Name of the registered CacheRepository (optional; defaults to system default).

CacheInvalidateStep.description: Cache Invalidate step — removes an entry from a CacheRepository.

key.description: Simple-language expression for the cache key to peek.

on_miss.description:
On-miss policy: `"stop"` (default) or `"continue"`. Invalid values fail YAML
conversion (named value) and compile (canonical/programmatic path).
`null` is valid and means the default.

repository.description: Name of the registered CacheRepository (optional; defaults to system default).

CachePeekStaleStep.description: Cache Peek Stale step — returns cached data even if TTL has expired.

repository.description: Name of the registered CacheRepository (optional; defaults to system default).

CacheStatsStep.description: Cache Stats step — emits the repository stats as a JSON body.

CacheStep.description:
Cache EIP step — puts/stores an exchange result in a `CacheRepository`.

Short-hand (`cache: "redis-cache"`) uses the URI directly as repository
name. Full form (`cache: { repository: ..., key: ..., ... }`) supplies the
full configuration with an `on_miss` sub-pipeline.

filter.description:
Optional filter string for selective merge-back during checkout operations.
Grammar: comma-separated tokens with optional `+`/`-`/`--` prefix.

key.description: Simple-language expression for the claim-check key (e.g. "${header.claimKey}").

CredentialSourceDsl.description:
Extraction source for a route's credential, as declared in YAML.

Accepted forms: `authorization_header` (bare string),
`{ query_param: { param: token } }`, `{ cookie: { name: session } }`,
`{ header: { name: X-API-Key } }`. The field values are the user-declared
parameter/cookie/header names; they must be non-empty after trimming and,
for `header`, a valid RFC 9110 token (validated at load time in `yaml.rs`).

oneOf.description: Extract the token from the `Authorization` header (Bearer scheme).
Extract the token from a query parameter with the given name.
Extract the token from a cookie with the given name.
Extract the token from a named request header (API-key style).

ExceptionDisposition.description:
Disposition for an exception handler or catch clause (ADR-0019).

# YAML casing

serde uses `lowercase` casing: `handled`, `propagate`, `continued`.

# Default divergence

`ExceptionDisposition::default()` returns `Propagate` (first variant per `#[derive(Default)]`),
but the YAML + builder layers default to `Handled` for doTry catch clauses
(via `default_handled_disposition()` in `camel-dsl/src/route_ast.rs` and the `DoCatchBuilder::do_catch_exception` constructor).
Direct struct construction should explicitly set disposition rather than relying on `Default`.

oneOf.description: After retry exhaustion / on_steps / DLC, re-throw to upstream.
Suppress re-throw. The handler's exchange is the final result.
Clear the error. The pipeline continues to the NEXT step.

eager.description: Reserve the key before running the child (default `false`).

expression.description: Simple-language expression that extracts the message-id (e.g. `"${header.messageId}"`).

remove_on_failure.description: When `eager`, remove the key if the child fails (default `false`).

steps.description: Child sub-pipeline executed on first-time (non-duplicate) exchanges.

message.description: The log message. Can be a plain string literal or a nested expression object.

LogMessageData.description:
The `message` field inside a `log: { message: ... }` config block.
Either a bare string literal or a value-source expression (simple, rhai, language+source).

count.description: Fixed iteration count. Mutually exclusive with `while`.

LoopWhileExpr.description: Expression-only predicate for loop while condition.

audiences.description:
Route-level audience override for the compiled security plan. When
present the plan's `audience_binding.audiences` uses these values
(issuers still come from the provider); when absent the resolved
provider's binding is copied verbatim. Valid only with the
`roles`/`scopes` forms (validated at load time in `yaml.rs`),
mirroring `provider`.

credential_sources.description:
Declared extraction sources for the route's credential, in order.
Absent → compile-time default `[authorization_header]`. Valid only with
the `roles`/`scopes` forms (validated at load time in `yaml.rs`).

provider.description:
Named authenticator provider to resolve the route's authenticator from
`SecurityCompileContext::providers`. Absent → sole provider (or legacy
single-authenticator) resolution. Valid only with the `roles`/`scopes`
forms (validated at load time in `yaml.rs`), mirroring
`credential_sources`.

ScatterGatherData.description:
Scatter-Gather EIP — stateless parallel fan-out + gather.
Lowers to Multicast with aggregation. No correlation key
(spec §5 "correlation key" wording corrected: stateless form
has none; stateful aggregation is the separate Aggregator EIP).

expression.description: Expression that extracts a sort key from each body element (e.g. simple: "${body.field}").

TransformStep.description: `transform:` step — alias for `set_body:`, reuses all SetBodyData types.

schema.description:
Optional JSON Schema. When present, the compiled UnmarshalService is
wrapped with a `JsonSchemaValidateService` that returns
`CamelError::ValidationError` (→ 400 Bad Request) on a mismatch.
Only effective when the format parses to `Body::Json` (currently `json`
is the only format that produces JSON in v1).

description:
Schema envelope for the public DSL surface.

Excludes templates (which use `noyalib::compat::serde_yaml::Value` —
a type that does not implement JsonSchema). Templates are internal
machinery; the public SDK schema is `{routes: [...]}` only.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL (mirrors RouteDslRoutes.schema_url — added in Task 9).
